==================
interface: opaque structs and host functions
==================

struct Doc
struct Selection { start: int, end: int }
enum SaveKind { Manual, Auto }

const MAX_DOC_BYTES: int = 1_000_000

fn text(doc: Doc) -> str
fn selection(doc: Doc) -> Selection
fn replace(doc: Doc, sel: Selection, new_text: str) -> Result[(), str]
fn generic[T](value: T) -> T

on saved(doc: Doc, kind: SaveKind) -> Result[(), str]
on init(settings: int) -> int
on shutdown()
